other_conditions: Applicant must be an Ex‑Serviceman or the widow of an Ex‑Serviceman
Ex‑Serviceman must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry

Scheme also applies to those Ex‑Servicemen or their living spouses/widows who are re‑employed as regular or deemed‑regular in Government, Public Sector Undertakings, Private Organizations, or are self‑employed in IT
benefits_summary: Festival Gift Coupons worth ₹4,000 per annum.
